title: Integrated Energy Planning in Uncertain Times
content: Integrated energy planning as referenced in this Column considers the interdependencies among and between energy resources and the infrastructures necessary to bring energy to market. This includes fuel-switching, transitioning end-use equipment and appliances from fossil-fuel use to electricity in buildings, transportation, and industrial sectors.
author: Paul A. DeCotis
